text:
merchant-care: Heads up — ACME (acct acme-123) reporting invoice INV-4521 failed to charge. Txn 0x7a3f9c, last4 4242, amount $12,420. Customer says 3DS challenge never appeared; browser console shows iframe blocked. PO required on merchant account too. Can someone triage?

emma: Thanks — can you paste the gateway trace and browser console snippet? Also did this happen on hosted checkout or inline iframe?

merchant-care: Hosted iframe. Console copy pasted below: 
```
POST https://gateway.redwood.example/charge 200 OK
Response: {"status":"declined","reason":"iframe_blocked","acquirer_code":"401.3","acs_status":"403","issuer_message":"AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED","acs_trans_id":"ACS-9bd3f"}
Error: Refused to display 'https://acs.issuer.example/challenge' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'DENY'.
```

raj: Looks like ACS returned X-Frame-Options: DENY which will break merchant iframe flows. Fallback should redirect to ACS challenge url — did the SDK attempt a redirect? If redirect was blocked client-side by CSP or sameSite cookie, challenge can fail and issuer can fallback to decline.

raj: Quick repro suggestion: on a dev merchant with same integration, force challenge mode with our debug flag and reproduce. Example curl to create a test charge with forced_challenge: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/charges 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" 
 -d '{"amount":12420,"currency":"USD","payment_method":{"type":"card","number":"4242424242424242","exp_month":12,"exp_year":2027},"three_d_secure":{"force_challenge":true},"merchant":{"id":"acme-123"}}'
```

olivia: Fraud signals: that card has AVS mismatch (zip not matching billing) and velocity = 9 attempts in 24h, fraud score 87. If we force retry there's risk of more soft declines. Recommend manual review or ask merchant to obtain alternative card. If merchant cannot manual review due to PO workflow, suggest whitelisting this merchant temporarily (sales/ops approval).

sre-jordan: Also note the issuer later returned insufficient_funds in a second attempt: acquirer log shows issuer_code 51 after auth fallback. Sequence looks like: challenge blocked -> fallback attempt -> issuer insufficient_funds -> decline. We should escalate ACS trace (ACS-9bd3f) and full gateway trace to the acquirer (/processor) for remediation.

sre-jordan: Short-term mitigations: 1) Ask merchant to switch to redirect flow (disable iframe) for affected customers. 2) If merchant uses autopay, recommend a retry policy that spaces attempts + notify customer to update card. 3) For high-value invoices, offer manual payment link (one-off) to avoid autopay loop.

emma: I'll open an acquirer escalation with logs and ACS trace. Merchant-care — tell ACME: try paying with different card or use the manual pay link; we can also toggle redirect for their checkout.

support-bot: Ticket created: TKT-78912 — "INV-4521: 3DS iframe blocked -> decline (ACS-9bd3f)". Linked traces: https://app.redwood.example/traces/0x7a3f9c and https://app.redwood.example/acs/ACS-9bd3f

emma: Action items:
- merchant-care: confirm whether ACME wants redirect flow enabled (reply here).
- raj: run repro on dev with forced_challenge and capture sequence.
- olivia: flag card for review and advise if we should block retries.
- emma: escalate to acquirer with attached traces.

merchant-care: ack — will ask ACME to try a different card and confirm if they want redirect enabled. Will update here. :thumbsup:
